keyFindings.description: The deletion is incomplete in the one agent-instruction file the change missed. The sentence still says the SPA "partitions it client-side into **Mine** (rows whose `issue.assignee` equals the lowercased `/auth/whoami` login, plus an **Unassigned** band with an `Assign to me` PATCH on issue rows) and **Everyone**, defaulting to Mine and remembering the choice per person (`inbox.view`); a `?view=mine|everyone` URL wins over the remembered choice." Every clause of that tail is now false: `parseInboxSearch` parses no `view` (routes.ts:803-830, and routes.test.ts:451 pins `?view=mine` as ignored), `inbox.view` is gone from `UserPreference` (userPreference.ts), `INBOX_SECTIONS` holds no `unassigned` band (sections.ts:13), and `Assign to me` is now a property of the row rather than of a band (Inbox.tsx:227). packages/dispatch/AGENTS.md:269,273 and seven docs-site/skill files were rewritten correctly; this one was missed. It is an auto-loaded context file, so the next agent that extends the Inbox reads the removed contract as current.

The change's own user documentation contradicts itself and the code on the project pill. The new paragraph says "**Needs you**, the banner, and a project's **Blocked on you** pill mean one thing wherever they appear: ... plus the credential requests waiting on you", while docs/site/src/content/docs/dispatch/issues-and-projects.md:29 — written by this same diff — says "It counts no credential request: a request belongs to no project." The code agrees with the second: ProjectPage.tsx:186-191 passes `asks`, `className`, `variant` and `viewer` only, and BlockedOnYou.tsx defaults `credentialRequests = []`. This is the settled spec departure (plan.json specDepartures[0]) carried into one documentation page and not the other. The PR body's third `Change` bullet repeats the wrong version.

The comment's premise and the PR body bullet are false for an agent-turn snoozed row. `tallyBySession(inbox.data ?? [], (ask) => ask.waiting_on === "agent")` applies no snooze test, and nothing stops a reader snoozing an agent-turn row: `SnoozeControl` renders on every row with no band condition (Inbox.tsx:236-241) and `sectionOf` sends any snoozed row to Later "whatever its turn" (sections.ts:83-91). So such a row is counted by the pill and sits folded inside `Later`, while the body bullet says "a snoozed question or another person's is in neither number". Counting it is defensible — a snooze is the reader's deferral, not a change of whose move it is — so the fix is the claim, or the predicate, not both.

The new `if (viewer === undefined) return { count: 0, oldest: undefined };` guard in `needsYou` is wider than the rule it protects. `waitingOnYou` already returns [] for an unknown viewer (BlockedOnYou.tsx:43), so the outer guard only adds the suppression of `credentialRequests`, which are not viewer-scoped (the doc comment at :47-48 says the reader may decide one "as its approver or as anyone signed in"). Effect, new in this diff — main's `needsYou` takes no viewer and has no guard — is that the rail badge and the banner hide pending credential requests while `/auth/whoami` is in flight.

Two comments still navigate by the deleted control: BulkSnoozeBar.tsx:50 "A fieldset, like the view switch: the group's name comes from its legend" (the view switch was the only other fieldset and this diff removed it), and packages/dispatch/e2e/keyboard-inbox.e2e.ts:622 "The `?agent=` chip narrows the list the same way the view switch does".
